name: Savory Cabbage Tarte Tatin

ingredients.name: buttery, Flaky Pie Dough or store-bought dough
chopped fresh thyme leaves, plus more for garnish
green cabbage head, cut into 1-inch wedges with core intact

instructions.primary_message: Prepare Buttery, Flaky Pie Dough according to the recipe. After rolling, folding, and dividing dough in half, roll one portion into a 25-cm round, 0.5 to 0.5-cm thick. (Save the other half for another use.) Transfer to a large, flat plate lined with parchment, or another similar arrangement. Working around circumference, fold 1.5 cm of dough over itself and pinch to create 23-cm round with raised rim. Cut three 5-cm slits in center of dough, and refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours.

Meanwhile, preheat oven to 200°C (400°F). Place sugar and 2 tablespoons of the vinegar in a 25-cm oven-safe stainless-steel skillet; heat over low, undisturbed, swirling and tilting pan occasionally, until mixture is light golden brown, 12 to 15 minutes. Increase heat to medium-low; swirl in butter, Dijon, thyme, salt, black pepper, and remaining 4 tablespoons vinegar; cook, stirring often, until thick and deep golden, 7 to 9 minutes. Remove from heat, pour in even layer into bottom of a 13-by 23-cm baking dish; clean and dry skillet. Place cabbage wedges in baking dish, overlapping as needed. (They won’t fit in an even layer, but will shrink as they cook). Bake, gently turning wedges every 20 minutes, until very tender and golden brown, about 1 hour.

Line a baking sheet with paper towels. Using a slotted spoon or slotted fish spatula, transfer cabbage to the prepared baking sheet, arranging wedges in an even layer, and allow drain. Discard remaining liquids from baking dish. Using clean paper towels, firmly press cabbage wedges to soak up any excess moisture.

Grease cleaned skillet with softened butter; arrange roasted cabbage wedges tightly in an even layer in rose pattern: Beginning in center of skillet, place small leaves/bits, slightly overlapping as needed; working out towards sides of pan, place cabbage wedges with narrow edge facing toward center, overlapping as needed until all wedges are used. Sprinkle evenly with Gruyère.

Carefully place pastry, rim side down, over cabbage, making sure it is centered and not touching skillet sides. Bake at 205°C (400°F) until crust is golden brown, 30 to 35 minutes. Transfer skillet to wire rack set; let cool for 5 minutes. Run a sharp knife or small offset around edges to loosen; place a plate over skillet, carefully invert tarte tatin onto plate. Garnish with additional thyme; slice and serve immediately.

description: This tart has a caramel-like sauce, tender cabbage, nutty Gruyère cheese, and a crispy crust for a vegetarian centerpiece that's gorgeous and delicious. Make it for any other special occasion.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 4 hr 25 min.

Make-ahead and storage: You can use 1/2 (400 g) package refrigerated pie dough, at room temperature, in place of homemade pie dough or 1 sheet frozen all-butter puff pastry, thawed.
author: Megan O. Steintrager
